lines.t: ‎[Intro - Spoken softly, reflective]
‎As the days grow darker and the hearts grow colder,
‎I see now how my silence, my turning away, has wounded many...
‎Everything I have done, or failed to do, affects the flock around me.
‎So I take this moment to confess before The Lord and before you all...
‎[Verse 1]
‎I'm sorry for the times I walked in my own way,
‎Chasing shadows of this world while you waited in pain.
‎I'm sorry for the hours I spent in idle slumber,
‎While the trumpet sounded and I closed my ears again.
‎I'm sorry for the pride that built walls around my heart,
‎Refusing the call when YahuShua knocked from the start.
‎I'm sorry I loved the traditions of men more than truth,
‎And let deception cover the eyes of the youth.
‎[Pre-Chorus]
‎I was blind, yet now I see the blood upon my hands,
‎The weight of my rebellion across these forsaken lands...
‎[Chorus]
‎You can put the blame on me,
‎You can put the blame on me,
‎You can put the blame on me...
‎Said you could put the blame on me.
‎I'll be the reason for your stumbling,
‎The cause of your falling away,
‎And you can put the blame on me...
‎You can put the blame on me.
‎[Verse 2]
‎I'm sorry for the days I spoke peace where there was none,
‎Smiling in houses of lies while the prophets were shunned.
‎I'm sorry I ignored the cries of the oppressed and poor,
‎While filling my belly and locking every door.
‎I'm sorry for the moments I chose comfort over the cross,
‎And let the fire of conviction grow cold and be lost.
‎I'm sorry I hardened my neck against The Lord's rebuke,
‎And dragged others down with me in this great pursuit.
‎[Pre-Chorus]
‎I was lost, yet now I kneel in the ashes of my sin,
‎Crying out for mercy where the healing can begin...
‎[Chorus]
‎You can put the blame on me,
‎You can put the blame on me,
‎You can put the blame on me...
‎Said you could put the blame on me.
‎I'll bear the shame of this generation's fall,
‎If it wakes one soul to answer the call...
‎And you can put the blame on me...
‎You can put the blame on me.
‎You can put the blame on me,
‎You can put the blame on me,
‎You can put the blame on me...
‎Yet hear this now, in the volumes spoken from above:
‎"For I know the thoughts of your heart, and the deceit therein;
‎Turn from your wicked ways, and I will heal your land.
‎But if you refuse, the calamity comes by your own hand."
‎So put the blame on me if you must, for my part in the night,
‎But rise up now, repent, step into the light.
‎YahuShua waits with arms open wide...
‎You can put the blame on me,
‎But let His mercy abide.
‎You can put the blame on me...
